unitNote: 40피트(40’) 컨테이너 1개 기준, 32일 미만 단기 FAK(Freight All Kind) 운임

routes.name: 극동 → 북유럽
routes.title: Xeneta Shipping Index by Compass - Far East to North Europe
routes.desc: The XSI-C - Far East to North Europe is an index administered under a governance framework aligned with the requirements of the EU Benchmarks Regulation. It represents rolling short-term Freight All Kind (FAK) rate valid for less than 32 days, for a 40’ container and from Far East to North Europe. They are calculated daily and published at 6:00pm CET.
